packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/__init__.name: Agent-tools package
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/__init__.description: Marks the agent-tools code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/account..name: Read a trading account
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/account..description: Lets an agent read a trading account: its balance, open positions and orders, and recent broker activity.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/agents.p.name: See & create agents
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/agents.p.description: Lets an agent see the other agents and create new persistent agents from the conversation, with a guard against runaway loops.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/artifact.name: Save & read files
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/artifact.description: Lets an agent save files and read back images and stored files it is allowed to see.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/base.py.name: Tool foundations
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/base.py.description: The shared foundation every agent tool is built on, including the stages an action's result can report.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/broker_c.name: Connect a broker
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/broker_c.description: Lets an agent connect, re-key or switch off the owner's trading account from chat, only on the owner's own typed request.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/browser_.name: Browser service
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/browser_.description: A separate, isolated web browser agents use to read pages, with no database, owner secrets or saved sign-ins of its own.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/browser..name: Browse the web (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/browser..description: The agent tool that reads a web page anonymously through the isolated research browser.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/capabili.name: Capabilities report
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/capabili.description: Builds the report of everything an agent can use right now, for the owner's Capabilities view and for agents.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/chart_in.name: Chart indicators
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/chart_in.description: Works out a technical indicator's values for a chart.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/chart_sn.name: Chart snapshot
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/chart_sn.description: Takes a picture of a chart's current state for an agent to look at.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/chart_st.name: Edit a chart
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/chart_st.description: Lets an agent read and change a chart: its symbol, timeframe, indicators and drawings.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/chart.py.name: Create a chart
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/chart.py.description: Lets an agent create a new chart.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/cli_toke.name: Command-line pass
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/cli_toke.description: Decides which commands get an agent's `lonora` pass, so one agent's pass never lands in another agent's process.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/collabor.name: Work together
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/collabor.description: Lets an agent start, inspect and finish working together with another agent.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/consult..name: Second opinion
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/consult..description: Lets an agent ask another configured model for an optional second opinion.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/context..name: Tool context
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/context..description: Carries the shared details every tool call needs: the owner, agent, run and database, the language of server text and the owner's time zone.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/environm.name: Tool inspection
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/environm.description: Lets a tool safely look at the real set of available tools.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/feeds.py.name: News feeds
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/feeds.py.description: Lets an agent read and subscribe to news and RSS feeds.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/incoming.name: Reach the owner
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/incoming.description: Lets an agent alert the owner or ask to reach him, spending his existing attention, and says truthfully whether the alert showed, is waiting, or was kept back.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/knowledg.name: Knowledge notes
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/knowledg.description: Lets an agent add, list and remove knowledge notes from chat.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/loader.p.name: Tool loader
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/loader.p.description: Loads the full set of agent tools.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/market_a.name: Market evidence
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/market_a.description: Lets an agent read market evidence for its own analysis — snapshots, sessions, the calendar and candles — never signals or orders.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/market_b.name: Market binding
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/market_b.description: Fills in which account and symbol a market tool call means, and guards the money tools for the run.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/market_w.name: Market watches
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/market_w.description: Lets an agent set, read, steer, pause and cancel live market watches, avoiding duplicate watches of the same thing.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/market.p.name: Read the market
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/market.p.description: Lets an agent read prices, quotes, candles and instrument details for a symbol.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/mcp.py.name: Outside AI connections
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/mcp.py.description: Lets an agent discover, review and use the tools of saved outside AI connections, checking who is allowed before any network call.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/memory.p.name: Memory (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/memory.p.description: Lets an agent read and write its durable memory and the shared owner profile, with version history it can restore.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/message..name: Message a peer
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/message..description: Lets an agent send a message or a reaction to another agent.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/models.p.name: Assign a model
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/models.p.description: Lets the owner, through chat, assign which AI model an agent uses.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/opportun.name: Opportunities (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/opportun.description: Lets an agent create, read, update and list trading opportunities it has spotted.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/owner_ac.name: Propose an action card
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/owner_ac.description: Lets an agent put an action card — including a Mandate card — in the conversation for the owner to decide; the result gives the stored card's live status, never that the owner saw it.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/performa.name: Read results
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/performa.description: Lets an agent read its own trading results.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/position.name: Position sizing
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/position.description: Works out a read-only size estimate for a trade; it never creates a trade proposal.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/profile_.name: Owner-observation guard
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/profile_.description: Decides whether a run may record Lonora's observations about the owner, based on whether it has read content others wrote.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/provenan.name: Who a run speaks for
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/provenan.description: Tracks whether a run acts on the owner's own words or on content others wrote, so outside input is never treated as the owner's instruction.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/registry.name: Tool registry
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/registry.description: Holds the full set of tools and marks which ones return content written by someone other than the owner.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/relation.name: Relationship evidence
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/relation.description: Lets a normal agent record and read one measured, read-only kind of evidence.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/resolve..name: Name resolving
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/resolve..description: Turns what the owner called something into the actual item, or asks which one when it is unclear.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/routine..name: Routines (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/routine..description: Lets an agent create and read its scheduled routines and switch them on or off.

GET /health.name: Browser health
GET /health.description: Reports whether the isolated research browser is up; an internal check, not reached from the apps.

POST /browse.name: Fetch a web page
POST /browse.description: Opens and reads a web page in the isolated research browser, refusing when it is busy and giving up if the page takes too long.
